name: Steve's Heating & Cooling
eyebrow: Heating · Cooling · Air quality — Riverside & the Northland since 1979
lede: Locally owned and serving Kansas City since 1979. Furnace and air conditioning installation, service and repair, with fair pricing and techs customers ask for by name. Not part of a national home services company.

card4.title: Cleaner, healthier air
card4.body: Duct cleaning, air cleaners and purifiers, humidifiers and dehumidifiers for Kansas City homes.

reviews.text: The technician got here within an hour of calling. He was very nice and replaced the capacitor within and hour. It was a great experience and I will definitely use them again!!!

This was a general service call. My HVAC stopped cooling and the condenser and evaporator coils froze. The technician showed up 15 minutes early and solved the issue within 2-3 minutes. Excellent mannerisms for customer service.
Fast, effective, very polite. Worth every penny.

areaLede: Based in Riverside, serving the Northland and beyond on both sides of State Line.
source: stevesheatingkc.com home page (facts, hours, service area, three customer reviews). HAS AN EXISTING WEBSITE: weak lead.

name: Arctic Air Heating & Cooling
eyebrow: Lennox Premier Dealer · Family owned since 1975 — Gladstone & Kansas City

card4.title: Lennox Premier Dealer

reviews.text: Very pleased with the price and installation of a new AC and furnace. Prompt, professional, have used Arctic Air for decades and will continue.
